amend.upstream.description: resolve the open findings while the coverage check is not covered: a finding that changes no scope takes its default decision (an agent, recorded as an assumption with its reason), a scope-changing one waits for a person's decision; the decision amends the questions and the requirements list, and the plan is marked as derived from an earlier requirements revision (a new revision), so Canon sets aside every record about the old one and the writer re-derives it

plan.cover.description: join the compiled commands and synthesized scenarios to the story bodies; only while no coverage check is recorded about the current plan revision

plan.decompose.description: write one story per group of commands under the epic through `aep plan artifact new`, each with `## ESS first` and `## Acceptance`; moves the plan to a new revision; while the current plan does not cover the specification, or a check of it failed (invalid, unassessed scope, stories not active): a failed check is left only by a new plan revision, and this is the action that writes one

plan.scope.description: run aep plan artifact waves --kind story; only while no scope check is recorded about the current plan revision

plan.status.description: read the AEP status of the epic and its stories; only while no status is recorded about the current plan revision

plan.validate.description: run aep plan artifact validate; only while no validation is recorded about the current plan revision

roadmap.read.description: copy the roadmap approval record of the sdc.direction case into this case, unchanged; it approves nothing, and the record keeps the producer and roadmap revision it was approved with. Only while this case holds no roadmap approval record about the current roadmap revision: a second copy with another result would leave roadmap.approved unknown for good. A new roadmap revision sets the old record aside and makes it admissible again

spec.gate.description: run the ESS gate over the current specification revision; only while no gate run is recorded about it (each observation of this protocol runs once per revision of what it reads: a second record with another result would leave its claim unknown for good)

findings.description: findings.yaml: the typed findings (ambiguity, contradiction, missing decision) any stage raised, each citing the items it conflicts with, with its status and its resolution

plan.description: the AEP epic and its stories; its revision is the planning store's commit

requirements.description: the requirements list from sdc.intake, amended by resolved findings

roadmap.description: the roadmap the epic belongs to

spec.description: the ESS specification; its revision is its spec digest

gate.checked.description: an ESS gate run is recorded about the current specification revision, whatever its result

gate.passed.description: the ESS gate passes on the current specification revision

plan.active.description: the epic and every story of the current plan are active in AEP

plan.cover_checked.description: a coverage check is recorded about the current plan revision, against the current specification revision, whatever its result

plan.covers_spec.description: the current plan covers every command and scenario of the current specification

plan.scope_checked.description: a scope check is recorded about the current plan revision, whatever its result

plan.scoped.description: every story of the current plan declares the surfaces it lands on

plan.status_read.description: the AEP status is recorded about the current plan revision, whatever its result

plan.valid.description: the current plan validates, against the current specification revision

plan.validated.description: a validation is recorded about the current plan revision, against the current specification revision, whatever its result

roadmap.approved.description: the current roadmap revision is approved

roadmap.copied.description: a roadmap approval record about the current roadmap revision is in this case, whatever its result

decomposition_coverage.description: every command of the compiled specification claimed by exactly one story and every synthesized scenario named by at least one; its result is covered, uncovered or finding (an open finding)

ess_gate.description: the ESS gate over a specification revision, the four checks run as one program; passed or failed

plan_validation.description: the result of `aep plan artifact validate`, valid or invalid

roadmap_approval.description: a person's approval of a roadmap revision; its result is approved

stories_scoped.description: `aep plan artifact waves --kind story`; its result is scoped (0 unassessed) or unassessed

story_states.description: the AEP status of the epic and each of its stories, read by `aep plan artifact list`; its result is active when every one is active, otherwise the least advanced status (draft, proposed, rejected)

spec.revised.description: a plan validation or coverage record observed against an earlier specification revision no longer applies

activation.required.description: the epic and its stories are active

gate.required.description: the ESS gate passes on the current specification revision

plan.required.description: the plan validates and covers the specification

gate_failed.description: the ESS gate failed on the specification revision its spec case passed (D166, route R10). Nothing in this case revises the specification, so no action is admissible after it; the case ends here by rule, the epic ends not_delivered and the root not_delivered. The gate program's crashed or unreadable run is a tool error and records nothing, so a recorded failure is a verdict about the specification

passed.description: the roadmap is approved, the ESS gate passes, and the current plan validates, covers the specification, is scoped and active

protocol.description: Decompose the epic's complete ESS specification into AEP stories under the epic. The plan is the AEP planning store's epic and its stories; every result is a program's: `aep plan artifact validate`, the decomposition coverage check (every command of the compiled specification claimed by exactly one story, every synthesized scenario named by one), `aep plan artifact waves --kind story` and the AEP status of the epic and its stories. No plan evidence comes from an LLM. No action is admissible before the roadmap is approved or while the ESS gate does not pass on the current specification revision. A revised specification invalidates the validation and coverage records observed against the earlier revision. The case ends passed. Late findings (docs/trial-2.md, "The late-finding loop"): the coverage check also reads the open findings and is not covered while one is open; amend.upstream resolves them by amending the questions and the requirements list upstream, and the plan is re-derived.
